description: Header file defining CUDAEvent class and CUDAEvent pool for managing CUDA events in PyTorch's CUDA backend.

classes.name: CUDAEvent
classes.description: Wrapper around CUDA's cudaEvent_t with management and synchronization features.

classes.name: EventPool
classes.description: Thread-safe pool for reusing CUDAEvent objects to optimize creation overhead.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Returns the device associated with the CUDAEvent if created.

methods.name: isCreated
methods.description: Checks if the CUDAEvent has been created.

methods.name: device_index
methods.description: Returns the device index associated with the event.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Checks if the event has completed.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records the event on the current CUDA stream.

methods.name: recordOnce
methods.description: Records the event once if not already recorded.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Makes a stream wait for the event to complete.

methods.name: elapsed_time
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time between two events.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the CPU thread with the event.

methods.name: ipc_handle
methods.description: Gets the IPC handle for the event.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates the CUDA event with specified device index.

methods.name: moveHelper
methods.description: Helper for move semantics, transferring ownership.
